apple.name: Dress My Wound
apple.subtitle: Your family's health records
apple.promotionalText: Keep your family's health information in one private place and find verified doctors and nurses in Egypt.
apple.description:
Dress My Wound brings your family's health information and care team together in one calm, private place.

KEEP YOUR HEALTH INFORMATION ORGANISED
• Record allergies, conditions, medications, past surgeries, blood type and an emergency contact.
• Everything you add is clearly marked as self-reported.

CARE FOR YOUR FAMILY
• Manage profiles for parents and children you are authorised to care for.
• Every family profile records the consent or legal authority behind it.

FIND VERIFIED CLINICIANS
• Browse doctors and nurses whose professional credentials have been reviewed by our team.
• See availability, services and approximate service areas.

TETRASOL STORE
• Browse TetraSol wound-care products in one dedicated store.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Health information is stored only with your explicit consent.
• Only you and the people you authorise can see your records.
• Delete your account at any time from inside the app.

IMPORTANT
Dress My Wound does not diagnose or treat and is not an emergency service. In an emergency in Egypt call 123.

Available in Arabic and English.

google.title: Dress My Wound
google.shortDescription: Your family's health records and verified doctors and nurses, in one place.
google.fullDescription:
Dress My Wound brings your family's health information and care team together in one calm, private place.

Keep your health information organised: allergies, conditions, medications, past surgeries, blood type and an emergency contact — always marked as self-reported.

Care for your family: manage profiles for parents and children you are authorised to care for, with the consent or legal authority recorded for each.

Find verified clinicians: browse doctors and nurses whose professional credentials have been reviewed by our team.

TetraSol store: browse TetraSol wound-care products in one dedicated store.

Private by design: health information is stored only with your explicit consent, only you and the people you authorise can see it, and you can delete your account at any time from inside the app.

Important: Dress My Wound does not diagnose or treat and is not an emergency service. In an emergency in Egypt call 123.

Available in Arabic and English.
